The '''Last words of Captain Naz Felyood''' was a hand-written message believed to be from the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Naz Felyood]], a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who crashed on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and was briefly possessed by the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]].
